executivePulse.interpretation: Memory and AI infrastructure remain under heavy pressure. Server DRAM, DRAM, HBM are currently among the most strained areas. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure, but will only reach the market with delay. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
